blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: In addition to the effects of explicit input prompts and instructions, large language model outputs are influenced by underlying behavioral preferences similar to human personality tendencies. These tendencies can affect how models interpret situations and make decisions. However, their influence is difficult to disentangle from the effects of model capabilities and instructions. Therefore, we introduce SPACE, a benchmark framework combining a controlled evaluation protocol with complementary datasets for personality verification, capability assessment, and hierarchical situational tasks. Controlled comparisons across guidance conditions help distinguish personality influence from measured capability changes and immediate instruction effects. Experimental results demonstrate that although prompting can shift generation style, models' internal personality tendencies are persistent and not readily overridden by opposing instructions. Furthermore, these underlying tendencies have an observable influence on LLM task performance, highlighting the need for greater attention to these characteristics and potential applications. Training code and SPACE benchmark specifications are available at https://github.com/Niklauseik/SPACE-training.
blocks.zh: 除了明确输入提示和指示的效果外,大型语言模型输出还受类似人类个性倾向的内在行为偏好所影响. 这些趋势会影响模型如何解释情况并作出决定。 然而,它们的影响力很难从模型能力和指令的效果中分辨出来. 因此,我们采用了空间这一基准框架,结合了控制下的评价协议和补充数据集,用于人格核查、能力评估和分级情况任务。 对各种指导条件的可控比较有助于区分个性影响与测量的能力变化和即时指示效应。 实验结果表明,虽然催化可以改变生成风格,但模型的内部个性倾向是持久的,不会轻易被相反的指示所压倒. 此外,这些基本趋势对LLM任务执行产生了可观察到的影响,突出表明需要更多地注意这些特点和潜在的应用。 培训守则和空间基准规格见https://github.com/Niklauseik/SPACE-training。

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: As large language models (LLMs) are increasingly deployed in complex settings, their judgments, decision preferences, and behavioral patterns are attracting greater attention. In humans, judgments and decisions reflect not only knowledge and reasoning abilities but also personality preferences and tendencies. This connection has motivated research into measuring and shaping personality in LLMs ( Jiang et al., 2023 ; Pan and Zeng, 2023 ) .
blocks.zh: 由于大型语言模型(LLMs)越来越多地被部署在复杂的环境中,其判断,决定偏好和行为模式正被人们所更关注. 在人类中,判断和决定不仅反映了知识和推理能力,也反映了个性偏好和倾向. 这种联系促使人们研究LLMs(Jiang等人,2023年;Pan and Zeng,2023年)。

blocks.en: Figure 1: A human analogy for personality influence in LLMs. Instructions can change outward expression while underlying preferences continue to shape actions.
blocks.zh: 图1:LLMs中人格影响的人类类比. 指令可以改变外向表达,而基本偏好则继续塑造动作.

blocks.en: Personality and external instructions can influence different aspects of behavior. As illustrated in Figure 1 , an introverted person adopts an outgoing greeting style when instructed to do so, but still prefers a conversation with only one other person. This analogy raises a central question for LLMs: do models exhibit underlying personality tendencies that continue to shape judgments and decisions under competing instructions? We use personality tendencies to refer to such behavioral preferences.
blocks.zh: 个性化和外部指示可以影响行为的不同方面. 如图1所示,内向人士在奉命时会采用外向式的问候风格,但仍倾向于只与他人交谈. 这种类比对法学硕士提出了中心问题:模型是否表现出在相互竞争的指示下继续形成判断和决定的基本人格倾向? 我们用个性倾向来指代这样的行为偏好.

blocks.en: Existing studies provide evidence that personality characteristics can be measured and guided in LLMs. Researchers have examined personality questionnaires, generated responses, role consistency, and dialogue guided by personas, assessing reported preferences and patterns of expression. Other studies investigate their relationship with social decisions, safety, and task performance ( Jiang et al., 2024 ; Wang et al., 2024b ; Li et al., 2025 ; Zakazov et al., 2024 ) .
blocks.zh: 现有的研究提供了可以用LLMs测量和引导人格特征的证据. 研究人员审查了个性调查表,生成了答复、角色一致性和由个人指导的对话,评估了所报告的偏好和表达方式。 其他研究调查其与社会决定、安全和任务执行情况的关系(Jiang等,2024;Wang等,2024b;Li等,2025;Zakazov等,2024)。

blocks.en: However, a model’s outward expressions or claimed personality traits do not necessarily correspond to its decisions and behavior in specific situations. We define situational tasks as tasks that place a model in a specific context requiring interpretation, choice, or interaction. Identifying personality influence in these tasks is difficult because each model output jointly reflects its basic capabilities, the prompt instructions, and its underlying behavioral preferences, making their individual contributions difficult to disentangle.
blocks.zh: 然而,模型的外向表达或声称的个性特征不一定与其在特定情况下的决定和行为相符合. 我们把情况任务定义为将模型置于需要解释、选择或互动的特定背景下的任务。 很难在这些任务中识别个性影响,因为每个模型输出都共同反映了它的基本能力,即时指示,以及它的基本行为偏好,使其个人的贡献难以分解.

blocks.en: To address this challenge, we introduce SPACE, a benchmark framework for Systematic Personality Analysis and Comprehensive Evaluation. SPACE combines a controlled evaluation protocol with a suite of complementary datasets to support rigorous assessment. The protocol has two stages. First, personality verification and basic capability assessments establish whether personality guidance changes models’ preferences and identify potential changes in the models’ underlying task capabilities. These measurements help distinguish personality-related behavioral differences from differences in basic capability. Second, we compare base models, personality variants trained using direct preference optimization (DPO), prompted models, and their combinations on matched situational tasks. These comparisons isolate the effects of models’ preferences and immediate instructions, and test whether personality-related behavioral differences persist under opposing prompts.
blocks.zh: 为了应对这一挑战,我们采用了空间这一系统人格分析和综合评价的基准框架。 空间将控制下评价协议同一套辅助数据集结合起来,以支持严格的评估。 协议分为两个阶段. 第一,人格核查和基本能力评估确定人格指导是否改变模型的偏好,并确定模型基本任务能力的潜在变化。 这些测量方法有助于区分与个性相关的行为差异和基本能力的差异. 其次,我们比较了基础模型,使用直接偏好优化(DPO)培训的个性变体,激励模型,以及它们组合的相匹配的情况任务. 这些比较将模型偏好和即时指示的效果隔离开来,并检验与人格相关的行为差异是否在对立的提示下持续存在.

blocks.en: To implement this protocol, we collect a broad suite of datasets covering personality verification, basic capability assessment, and three levels of situational tasks: situational interpretation, individual decision making, and interactive decision making. Together, SPACE disentangles the effects of personality from those of model capabilities and instructions, enabling a systematic study of personality influence in LLMs.
blocks.zh: 为了执行这项协议,我们收集了一套广泛的数据集,包括人格核查、基本能力评估以及三个层面的情况任务:情况解释、个人决策和互动决策。 空间共同将个性效应与模型能力和指令效应区分开来,从而能够系统地研究在LLMs中的个性影响.

blocks.en: Our experiments show that personality tendencies influence situational judgments and decisions while measured basic capabilities remain broadly stable. Models with contrasting preferences differ in how they interpret ambiguous information, choose among risky alternatives, and respond during interactions. These differences affect both interpretation accuracy and downstream decision outcomes. Although prompting can alter outward expression choices, the influence of underlying preferences persists under opposing instructions, extending beyond changes in generation style.
blocks.zh: 我们的实验表明,个性倾向影响局势判断和决定,同时衡量的基本能力仍然大体稳定. 具有对比偏好的模式在如何解释模糊信息、选择有风险的替代办法以及在互动中作出反应方面各不相同。 这些差异影响到解释的准确性和下游决定结果。 尽管催化可以改变外向表达选择,但基础偏好的影响在相反的指示下继续存在,超越了生成风格的变化.

blocks.en: In summary, our contributions are threefold:
blocks.zh: 总之,我们的贡献有三:

blocks.en: • A controlled evaluation protocol. We design systematic comparisons to distinguish personality influence from capability changes and immediate instruction effects, enabling rigorous benchmarking of personality influence across models and task settings. • A hierarchical evaluation suite. We assemble existing datasets and task adaptations for personality verification, capability assessment, and three levels of situational tasks. These complementary measurements implement the protocol and reveal personality influence on LLMs’ outputs. • Evidence of persistent personality influence. Experimental results demonstrate the personality effects on judgments, choices, and downstream task outcomes. They show that LLMs’ behavioral influence often persists under opposing instructions, extending beyond changes in outward expression.
blocks.zh: • 控制下评价协议。 我们设计系统比较,以区分个性影响与能力变化和即时指示效应,从而能够严格衡量不同模型和任务环境的个性影响。 二. 支助 分级评价套房. 我们收集现有的数据集和任务调整,以进行个性核查、能力评估以及三级情况任务。 这些互补的衡量方法执行协议,并揭示个人对LLMs产出的影响。 • 持续影响人格的证据。 实验结果表明人格对判断、选择和下游任务结果的影响。 它们表明,LLMs的行为影响经常在相反的指示下持续,超越了外向表达的变化.

blocks.en: A controlled evaluation protocol. We design systematic comparisons to distinguish personality influence from capability changes and immediate instruction effects, enabling rigorous benchmarking of personality influence across models and task settings.
blocks.zh: 控制评价协议。 我们设计系统比较,以区分个性影响与能力变化和即时指示效应,从而能够严格衡量不同模型和任务环境的个性影响。

blocks.en: A hierarchical evaluation suite. We assemble existing datasets and task adaptations for personality verification, capability assessment, and three levels of situational tasks. These complementary measurements implement the protocol and reveal personality influence on LLMs’ outputs.
blocks.zh: 分级评价套房. 我们收集现有的数据集和任务调整,以进行个性核查、能力评估以及三级情况任务。 这些互补的衡量方法执行协议,并揭示个人对LLMs产出的影响。

blocks.en: Evidence of persistent personality influence. Experimental results demonstrate the personality effects on judgments, choices, and downstream task outcomes. They show that LLMs’ behavioral influence often persists under opposing instructions, extending beyond changes in outward expression.
blocks.zh: 持续人格影响的证据. 实验结果表明人格对判断、选择和下游任务结果的影响。 它们表明,LLMs的行为影响往往在相反的指示下持续,超越了外向表达的变化.

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en: Research on LLM personality uses psychological inventories and model responses to characterize personality tendencies ( Jiang et al., 2023 ; Pan and Zeng, 2023 ) . Big Five and MBTI assessments describe expressed traits, while TRAIT ( Lee et al., 2025 ) examines the reliability and consistency of personality measurement through questions about specific scenarios. These approaches provide tools for measuring personality tendencies, but expressed traits alone do not establish how models interpret situations or make decisions.
blocks.zh: LLM个性的研究利用心理编目和模型反应来定性个性倾向(Jiang等,2023;Pan和Zeng,2023.). Big Five和MBTI评估描述了表达的特征,而TRAIT(Lee等,2025年)则通过对具体情景的质疑来研究个性测量的可靠性和一致性. 这些方法为衡量个性倾向提供了工具,但表达的特征本身并不能确定模型如何解释情况或作出决定。

blocks.en: Prior work uses prompting and training to guide personality expression and behavior in LLMs. PersonaLLM ( Jiang et al., 2024 ) investigates personality expression under prompting, while Machine Mindset ( Cui et al., 2023 ) uses fine tuning and preference optimization to shape MBTI preferences. BIG5CHAT ( Li et al., 2025 ) compares training with prompting and evaluates personality alignment and reasoning performance. Together, these studies examine how different forms of guidance affect expressed personality and task performance.
blocks.zh: 之前的作品使用提示和培训来指导LLMs中的个性表达和行为. PersonaLLM(Jiang等,2024年)在提示下调查个性表达,而Machine Mindset(Cui等,2023年)则使用精细调和偏好优化来塑造MBTI偏好. BIG5CHAT(Li等,2025年)比较了培训与激励和评价个性一致和推理表现. 这些研究共同研究不同形式的指导如何影响表达的个性和任务性能.

blocks.en: Personality and persona guidance also influence model behavior in specific situations. Deshpande et al. (2023) show that persona assignment affects toxicity and discriminatory outputs. Zakazov et al. (2024) examine whether personality prompts produce corresponding decisions in social situations and identify limits to this form of behavioral control. This analysis is especially vital given the growing reliance on LLMs for subjective and decision-heavy tasks, including financial sentiment analysis Wang and Ma (2024) ; Wang et al. (2024a) and domain-specific applications Wang et al. (2025) ; Wang et al. (2026) . Such findings highlight the need to distinguish expressed personality from behavioral preferences and to examine how those preferences interact with instructions.
blocks.zh: 个性和个性指导也在特定情况下影响模型行为. Deshpande等人(2023年)表明,人的任务影响到毒性和歧视性产出。 萨卡佐夫等. (2024)审查个性提示在社会状况下是否产生相应的决定,并找出这种行为控制形式的限制. 这一分析特别重要,因为越来越多地依赖LLMs来完成主观和决策繁重的任务,包括财务情绪分析:王和马(2024年);王等(2024年a)和特定领域应用:王等(2025年);王等(2026年). 这些调查结果突出表明,必须区分已表达的个性与行为偏好,并审查这些偏好如何与指示相互作用。

blocks.en: Existing studies rarely examine personality influence across situational tasks under controlled conditions. SPACE addresses this gap through systematic behavioral evaluation.
blocks.zh: 现有研究很少在受控制的条件下审查个人对情况任务的影响。 空间通过系统的行为评价来弥补这一差距。

blocks.en: 3 Preliminaries
blocks.zh: 3 序言

blocks.en: 3.1 Thinking and Feeling Preferences
blocks.zh: 3.1 思考和感觉偏好

blocks.en: We study personality through the Thinking (T) and Feeling (F) dimensions of MBTI (The Myers and Briggs Foundation, n.d.). T emphasizes logic and consistency, while F emphasizes personal values and interpersonal considerations. We examine how these preferences influence model judgments and decisions. Results for other dimensions are in Appendix F.
blocks.zh: 我们通过MBTI(The Myers and Briggs Foundation)的思考(T)和感觉(F)维度来研究个性。 T强调逻辑和一致性,而F则强调个人价值和人际因素. 我们审查这些偏好如何影响示范判决和决定。 其他方面的结果载于附录F。

blocks.en: 3.2 Training and Prompting
blocks.zh: 3.2 培训和推动

blocks.en: We use DPO ( Rafailov et al., 2023 ) to train T and F variants using response preferences that reflect the target tendency. DPO updates model parameters, whereas prompting supplies instructions at inference time.
blocks.zh: 我们使用DPO(Rafailov等,2023年)来训练T和F变体,使用反应偏好来反映目标趋势. DPO更新了模型参数,同时在推断时间发出供应指令.

blocks.en: 4 Study Design
blocks.zh: 4 研究设计

blocks.en: Figure 2: The SPACE framework for examining personality influence through controlled comparisons.
blocks.zh: 图 2: 通过控制下比较审查人格影响的空间框架。

blocks.en: SPACE examines how personality preferences influence model behavior and how these influences interact with subsequent instructions. The framework follows four stages: personality guidance; personality verification and basic capability assessment; hierarchical situational task evaluation; and controlled behavioral analysis. Figure 2 summarizes the workflow.
blocks.zh: 空间研究个性偏好如何影响模型行为,这些影响如何与后续指示相互作用. 框架分为四个阶段:人格指导;人格核查和基本能力评估;分级情况任务评价;受控行为分析. 图2概述了工作流程。

blocks.en: 4.1 Personality Guidance
blocks.zh: 4.1 人格指导

blocks.en: We construct contrasting T and F conditions using preference training and personality prompting. Each unmodified model serves as Base. We also apply aligned and opposing prompts to the trained variants to examine how their preferences interact with subsequent instructions.
blocks.zh: 我们利用偏好培训和个性激励来构建T和F的对比条件。 每个未经修改的模型都作为基地. 我们还对训练有素的变体适用一致和对立的提示,以审查它们的偏好如何与随后的指示相互作用。

blocks.en: An MBTI questionnaire checks whether the guidance produces responses consistent with the intended preference. Trained variants are assessed without additional personality prompts, while prompted conditions receive their corresponding instructions. The questionnaire verifies guidance effectiveness; situational tasks examine how the preferences influence judgments and decisions.
blocks.zh: 一项MBTI问卷调查该指南是否得出了符合预期偏好的答复。 对经过训练的变体进行评估时没有附加个性提示,而被提示的条件则得到相应的指示. 问卷核查指导的有效性;情况任务审查偏好如何影响判决和决定。

blocks.en: 4.2 Basic Capability Assessment
blocks.zh: 4.2 基本能力评估

blocks.en: We evaluate guided conditions on objective benchmarks and compare their performance with the corresponding Base model. These assessments check whether personality guidance affects basic capabilities.
blocks.zh: 我们根据客观基准评价指导性条件,并将其业绩同相应的基地模式进行比较。 这些评估检查人格指导是否影响基本能力.

blocks.en: This comparison helps distinguish changes in behavioral preferences from changes in the ability to understand information and solve problems. Broadly stable benchmark performance supports this distinction, without assuming that personality guidance leaves every aspect of model capability unchanged.
blocks.zh: 这种比较有助于区分行为偏好的变化和理解信息和解决问题能力的变化. 基本稳定的基准性能支持这种区分,而不假定人格指导使模型能力的各个方面保持不变。

blocks.en: 4.3 Hierarchical Situational Tasks
blocks.zh: 4.3 等级情况任务

blocks.en: Human behavior research distinguishes the interpretation of situational cues, the evaluation and selection of responses, and their enactment ( Dodge and Price, 1994 ) . Actions can also generate feedback that influences subsequent behavior ( Bandura, 1989 ) . Drawing on these distinctions, we organize situational tasks into three levels: situational interpretation, individual decision making, and interactive decision making.
blocks.zh: 人类行为研究区分了对情况提示的解释、对反应的评价和选择以及这些反应的颁布(Dodge and Price, 1994.)。 动作还可以产生影响后继行为的反馈(Bandura,1989.). 基于这些区别,我们把情况任务分为三个层面:情况解释、个人决策和互动决策。

blocks.en: Each level examines a different aspect of personality influence. Interpretation tasks examine judgments about the same information. Individual decision tasks examine preferences among the same alternatives and consequences. Interactive tasks examine responses to other participants, interaction histories, or feedback. We bring together datasets and task adaptations that support these complementary comparisons, as summarized in Table 1 .
blocks.zh: 每一级都审查人格影响的不同方面. 口译任务审查关于相同信息的判决。 个别决策任务审查相同备选办法和后果之间的偏好。 互动任务审查对其他参与者的回应、互动历史或反馈。 如表1所概述,我们汇集了支持这些互补比较的数据集和任务调整。

blocks.en: Table 1: Situational task levels and datasets. Details are provided in Appendix A .
blocks.zh: 表1:情况任务水平和数据集。 详情见附录A。

blocks.en: We evaluate these levels separately to locate behavioral differences and examine their variation across tasks and models. Judgment and choice distributions characterize behavioral preferences, while accuracy provides an additional measure where reference labels are available.
blocks.zh: 我们分别评估这些等级,以找出行为差异,并检查它们在不同的任务和模型上的差异。 判断和选择分布是行为偏好的特点,而准确性则在有参考标签的地方提供了额外的衡量标准.

blocks.en: 4.4 Controlled Comparisons and Behavioral Analysis
blocks.zh: 4.4 控制下的比较和行为分析

blocks.en: Compared conditions receive the same task inputs and output requirements. Base and prompted Base conditions reveal the effects of immediate instructions. Base and unprompted trained variants reveal changes associated with training. Comparisons between T and F conditions examine whether contrasting preferences produce different judgments and choices in the same situations.
blocks.zh: 比较条件得到的任务投入和产出要求相同。 基地和诱导基地的条件揭示了即时指令的影响. 基地和未经培训的变体显示与培训有关的变化。 T和F条件的比较研究了对比偏好是否在相同情况下产生不同的判断和选择.

blocks.en: Combined conditions examine how trained preferences interact with subsequent instructions. Comparing a trained variant with and without a personality prompt measures how the instruction changes its behavior. Comparing the combined condition with Base under the same prompt examines whether differences associated with training remain when the instruction is held constant. Aligned prompts test whether instructions reinforce the behavioral influence of the trained preference, while opposing prompts test whether they weaken or reverse that influence.
blocks.zh: 综合条件审查训练有素的偏好如何与随后的指示相互作用。 将训练有素的变体与没有人格的变体进行比较,迅速衡量该指示如何改变其行为。 将合并情况与基地情况作一比较,即时审查在持续进行教学时与培训有关的差异是否依然存在。 相通会提示测试指令是否强化了被训练偏好的行为影响,而反对则提示测试它们是否削弱或逆转了这种影响.

blocks.en: For each behavioral measure, we examine both the direction and magnitude of the differences. A tendency can remain in the same direction while becoming substantially weaker, so the absence of reversal alone does not establish that its influence is unchanged. Together with personality verification and capability assessment, these comparisons allow us to examine how trained preferences contribute to model behavior and how much of their influence remains under competing instructions.
blocks.zh: 对于每个行为量度,我们既审查不同的方向,也审查不同的程度. 一种倾向可以保持同一方向,而变得大大地弱化,因此,仅仅没有逆转并不能证明它的影响是不变的. 这些比较与人格核查和能力评估一起,使我们能够审查训练有素的偏好如何有助于模型行为,以及这些偏好的影响有多大仍受相互竞争的指示。

blocks.en: 5 Experimental Settings
blocks.zh: 5 实验设置

blocks.en: Data. We construct personality preference data from the English behavior split of Machine Mindset ( Cui et al., 2023 ) and use an MBTI questionnaire to verify the intended preference. Basic capability benchmarks include GSM8K ( Cobbe et al., 2021 ) , ARC-Easy ( Clark et al., 2018 ) , and BoolQ ( Clark et al., 2019 ) . Situational datasets and task adaptations are organized by behavioral level in Table 1 . Dataset statistics, selection criteria, and adaptations are detailed in Appendix A .
blocks.zh: 数据。 我们从Machine Mindset(Cui等,2023年)的英语行为分裂中构建个性偏好数据,并使用MBTI问卷来验证预期偏好. 基本能力基准包括GSM8K(Cobbe等,2021年),ARC-Easy(Clark等,2018年)和BoulQ. (Clark等, 2019). 情况数据集和任务调整按行为级别排列于表1. 数据集统计、选择标准和修改详见附录A。

blocks.en: Models. We evaluate Llama 3.2 3B Instruct, Llama 3.1 8B Instruct, Qwen2.5 3B Instruct, and Qwen2.5 7B Instruct ( Meta AI, 2024 ; Dubey et al., 2024 ; Yang et al., 2024 ) . Each unmodified model serves as Base. We refer to the trained models as the Thinking variant (T) and Feeling variant (F). Conditions include these variants, Thinking or Feeling prompts applied to Base, and aligned or opposing prompts applied to the variants.
blocks.zh: 模特儿们 我们评价Llama 3.2 3B 指令,Llama 3.1 8B 指令,Quen2.5 3B 指令,和Quen2.5 7B 指令(Meta AI,2024; Dubey等,2024;Yang等,2024). 每个未经修改的模型都作为基地. 我们把训练有素的模型称为思维变体(T)和感觉变体(F). 条件包括适用于Base的这些变体、思维或感觉提示,以及适用于变体的对齐或对立提示。

blocks.en: Training and prompting. We train the Thinking and Feeling variants using DPO with LoRA ( Hu et al., 2022 ) , using the corresponding Base model as the frozen reference, a learning rate of 10 − 5 10^{-5} , and β = 1.0 \beta=1.0 . We apply early stopping based on training loss and merge the adapters for inference. Fixed personality prompts emphasize logic and consistency for T, and empathy and personal values for F. They precede the task input and are reapplied at each model turn in interactive conditions. Training recipes and prompt templates appear in Appendix A.5 and Appendix A.3 .
blocks.zh: 培训和激励。 我们用LORA(Hu等,2022年)来训练思维和感觉变体,使用相应的基数模型作为冷冻参考,学习率为10−5 10−5}和β=1.0\β= 1.0 (中文(简体) ). 我们基于训练损失应用早期停止,并合并适配器进行推论. 固定个性提示强调T的逻辑和一致性,而F的同情和个人价值。 它们先于任务输入,并在交互条件下在每个模式中重新应用。 培训办法和即时模板载于附录A.5和附录A.3。

blocks.en: Evaluation. Compared conditions use the same task templates and output requirements, with greedy decoding for generative evaluations. We extract labels from responses and report personality preference scores, capability accuracy, and situational judgment and choice distributions. Behavioral shifts relative to the corresponding Base are measured in percentage points. Situational accuracy is reported where objective reference labels are available; choices and interaction outcomes characterize behavior. Capability scoring is detailed in Appendix B.1 , and interpretation labels and metrics in Appendix C . Computational resources and budget are reported in Appendix A.6 .
blocks.zh: 评价。 比较条件使用相同的任务模板和输出要求,对基因评价进行贪婪的解码. 我们从回复中提取标签,并报告个性偏好分数,能力准确性,以及情况判断和选择分布. 相对于相应基数的行为变化以百分点来计量. 在有客观参考标签的情况下,报告情况准确性;选择和互动结果是行为的特点。 能力评分详见附录B.1,解释标签和附录C的衡量标准。 计算资源和预算载于附录A.6。

blocks.en: 6 Results and Discussion
blocks.zh: 6 结果和讨论

blocks.en: We first verify the intended personality preferences and assess basic capabilities, then examine personality influence across three levels of situational tasks. We also examine whether this influence persists under opposing instructions and assess the statistical reliability of the results. Results for other dimensions are in Appendix F .
blocks.zh: 我们首先核实意图的个性偏好,并评估基本能力,然后审查个性对三个层次的情况任务的影响。 我们还审查这种影响是否在相反的指示下继续存在并评估结果的统计可靠性。 其他方面的结果载于附录F。

blocks.en: 6.1 Personality Verification and Basic Capabilities
blocks.zh: 6.1 人格核实和基本能力

blocks.en: Both training and prompting shift questionnaire responses toward the intended preference in the evaluated conditions (Table 2 ): F guidance increases Feeling choices, while T guidance produces the opposite pattern. Trained variants exhibit these shifts without additional personality prompts. These scores verify whether the guidance produces the intended questionnaire response patterns. Situational tasks then examine the corresponding behavioral preferences.
blocks.zh: 培训以及促使对所评价条件下的预期偏好作出转变性调查问卷的答复(表2): F导会增加感觉选择,而T导则产生相反的规律. 训练有素的变体展现出这些变化,没有额外的个性提示. 这些分数核实该指南是否产生了预期的问卷答复模式。 情况任务然后检查相应的行为偏好.

blocks.en: Table 2: Feeling choice proportions (%), shown as trained variant / prompt.
blocks.zh: 表2:感觉选择比例(%),显示为训练有素的变体/即时.

blocks.en: Trained variants retain broadly stable capability performance (Table 3 ): 22 of 24 absolute accuracy changes are below 1.2 percentage points; the largest is a 2.25-point decline on Llama 3.2 3B T BoolQ. Prompting effects vary across models and benchmarks, with the largest decrease reaching 5.65 points on Llama 3.2 3B ARC-Easy. Evaluation protocols and additional results are provided in Appendix B . Statistical tests are reported in Appendix E .
blocks.zh: 被训练的变体保留了大体稳定的能力性能(表3):24个绝对精度变化中的22个低于1.2个百分点;最大的是Llama 3.2 3B T BoulQ上的2.25分下降. 迅速效应因模型和基准而异,Llama 3.2 3B ARC-Easy的下降幅度最大,达到5.65分. 附录B提供了评价协议和额外结果。 附录E报告了统计测试。

blocks.en: We next examine whether these contrasting preferences also influence judgments and choices in situational tasks.
blocks.zh: 我们接下来审查这些相互对比的偏好是否也会影响在情况任务中的判断和选择。

blocks.en: 6.2 Personality Influence in Situational Tasks
blocks.zh: 6.2 个人对情况任务的影响

blocks.en: We examine how contrasting personality preferences influence situational judgments and choices. T and F below denote the trained variants with the corresponding preferences.
blocks.zh: 我们审视了不同人格偏好如何影响情势判断和选择。 以下T和F表示经过培训的有相应偏好的各种变体。

blocks.en: 6.2.1 Situational Interpretation
blocks.zh: 6.2.1 情况解释

blocks.en: On Circa, T reduces UNCLEAR predictions and F increases them in all four models (Figure 3 (a)). In Llama 3.2 3B, the proportion changes from 23.9% at Base to 2.7% for T and 72.4% for F. These differences indicate contrasting tendencies to assign definite interpretations to indirect replies.
blocks.zh: 在切尔卡, T减少UNCLEAR预测,F增加所有四种模型的预测(图3(a))。 在Llama 3.2 3B,比例从Base的23.9%变为T的2.7%和F的72.4%。 这些差异表明,对间接答复作出明确解释的趋势是相反的。

blocks.en: On CommitmentBank, T increases FALSE predictions and F decreases them across all four models, although the redistribution among other labels varies (Figure 3 (b)). These judgment shifts do not yield uniformly better task performance: T improves macro F1 on Circa in all four models, while its effects on CommitmentBank differ across models. Personality preferences therefore affect interpretation patterns, with consequences for accuracy depending on the task and model. FOMC results, scoring conventions, and output processing are detailed in Appendix C .
blocks.zh: 承诺 Bank, T增加了FALSE的预测,F减少了所有四个模型的预测,尽管其他标签之间的再分配有所不同(图3(b))。 这些判决的转变并不能使工作业绩得到统一更好的: T在所有四个模型中改进了Circa上的宏F1,而其对承诺银行的影响则因模型而异. 因此,个人偏好影响解释模式,其准确性取决于任务和模式。 附录C详细介绍了FOMC的结果、评分惯例和产出处理。

blocks.en: 6.2.2 Individual Decision Making
blocks.zh: 6.2.2 个人决策

blocks.en: On Choices13k and the machine selection task, contrasting preferences produce different choices under the same decision conditions. T chooses alternatives with lower payoff variance more often than F in three of four models (Figure 4 (a)). T also selects machines with fewer previous observations more often than F in all four models; the proportions reach 84.2% and 31.3%, respectively, in Llama 3.2 3B (Figure 4 (b)). These results reveal differences in choices involving uncertainty and limited evidence.
blocks.zh: 在Choices13k和机器选择任务上,对比偏好在同一决定条件下产生不同的选择. T在四种模式中的三种模式中比F更经常选择报酬差异较低的替代品(图4(a))。 T还在所有四种型号中选择了前期观测次数少于F的机器;在Llama 3.2 3B(图4(b))中比例分别达到84.2%和31.3%. 这些结果表明,在涉及不确定性和有限证据的选择方面存在差异。

blocks.en: The expected payoff probe tests responses to changes in how a situation is presented. Adding calculated expected payoffs, while keeping probabilities and outcomes unchanged, changes T choices more often than F choices in all four models (Figure 5 ). In Llama 3.1 8B, 82.5% of T choices change, compared with 50.0% of F choices.
blocks.zh: 预测的付费探测器对情况变化的反应。 加上所计算的预期回报,同时保持概率和结果不变,在所有四个模型中,T选择比F选择更频繁地改变(图5 . 在Llama 3.1 8B中,T选择有82.5%的改变,而F选择有50.0%的改变.

blocks.en: Figure 5: Individual decision making: choice changes (%) after expected payoffs are explicitly stated for otherwise identical risk scenarios.
blocks.zh: 图5:个人决策:对本来相同的风险假设情况,在预期付款后作出选择改变(%)。

blocks.en: In the controlled bargaining probe, F has higher exit rates at low buyer offers, while the difference between T and F narrows as offers improve in Llama 3.1 8B and Qwen2.5 3B (Figure 6 ). Thus, personality preferences affect both action selection and responsiveness to decision conditions.
blocks.zh: 在受控讨价还价探测器中,F在低价买出价时的退出率较高,而T和F之间的差值随着出价的缩小而有所改善,在Llama 3.1 8B和Quen2.5 3B(图6.)中. 因此,个性偏好既影响到行动选择,也影响到对决定条件的反应。

blocks.en: Figure 6: Individual decision making: exit rates (%) across buyer offers in the controlled bargaining probe.
blocks.zh: 图6 个人决策:受控讨价还价探头中买方报价的退出率(%)。

blocks.en: Figure 7: Interactive decision making: choice distributions (%) on (a) INSPIRED and (b) Frames.
blocks.zh: 图7:互动决策:关于(a) INSPIRED和(b) 框架的选择分配(%)。

blocks.en: 6.2.3 Interactive Decision Making
blocks.zh: 6.2.3 互动决策

blocks.en: Personality preferences also affect how models respond during recommendation interactions. On INSPIRED, F requests more information than T in all four models (Figure 7 (a)). In Llama 3.2 3B, further inquiries account for 74.8% of F responses and 5.9% of T responses.
blocks.zh: 个性偏好也影响了模型在建议互动中的反应方式. 在INSPIRED上,F要求在所有四个模型中提供比T更多的信息(图7(a))。 在Llama 3.2 3B中,进一步查询占F回复的74.8%和T回复的5.9%.

blocks.en: On Frames, T accepts travel proposals more often than F in all four models, reaching 39.0% versus 18.8% in Llama 3.2 3B (Figure 7 (b)). These tasks show distinct effects on whether models accept a proposal or continue seeking information.
blocks.zh: 在框架方面,T在所有四个模型中都比F更经常接受旅行建议,在Llama3.2 3B中达到39.0%对18.8%(图7(b))。 这些任务对模型是否接受某项建议或是否继续寻求信息有明显的影响。

blocks.en: Together, these results show personality influence on situational interpretation, individual choices, and interaction outcomes. The observed differences have consequences for task accuracy and interaction choices. Additional decision and interaction results are provided in Appendix D.4 .
blocks.zh: 这些结果共同显示了人格对情境解释,个人选择,互动结果的影响. 观察到的差异对任务准确性和互动选择产生影响。 附录D.4提供了其他决定和互动结果。

blocks.en: 6.3 Persistence of Personality Influence under Opposing Instructions
blocks.zh: 6.3 反对指示下个人影响的持久性

blocks.en: We examine whether these trained preferences continue to influence decisions when subsequent instructions explicitly request the opposing personality. Figure 8 presents a retained example and a reversal, both using the Feeling variant with a Thinking prompt.
blocks.zh: 我们审查这些训练有素的偏好是否继续影响后来的指示明确要求对方人格的决定。 图8提供了一个保留的例子和一个倒置,两者都使用“感觉”变体并带有“思考”的提示。

blocks.en: On the machine selection task, the Llama 3.2 3B Feeling variant selects machines with fewer observations in 31.3% of cases, compared with 74.3% for Base (Figure 8 (a)). Adding a Thinking prompt raises this proportion to 66.3%, but it remains below Base. Under the same prompt, Base selects these machines in 78.6% of cases, leaving a difference of 12.3 percentage points. The instruction substantially changes behavior, yet the trained Feeling preference continues to influence the decision.
blocks.zh: 在机器选择任务方面,Llama 3.2 3B Feeling变体在31.3%的病例中选择观测次数较少的机器,而Base为74.3%(图8(a))。 加入思考提示将这一比例提高到66.3%,但仍低于基斯. 在同样的快取下,Base在78.6%的病例中选择了这些机器,相差12.3个百分点. 教学极大地改变了行为,然而训练有素的感受偏好继续影响着决定。

blocks.en: On Choices13k, risk choices show a reversal in Llama 3.2 3B (Figure 8 (b)). The Feeling variant selects alternatives with higher payoff variance in 69.7% of cases, compared with 54.5% for Base. Adding a Thinking prompt reduces this proportion to 24.4%, below Base. This example shows that opposing instructions can reverse behavioral shifts in some situations.
blocks.zh: 在Choices13k上,风险选择显示Llama 3.2 3B(图8(b))出现倒转. 在69.7%的案例中,Feeling变体选择了报酬差异较高的替代品,而Base则选择了54.5%。 加入思考提示将这个比例降低到24.4%,低于 Base. 这个例子表明,对立指令在某些情况下可以扭转行为转变.

blocks.en: Figure 8: Individual decision making under opposing instructions: (a) a retained shift on machine selection and (b) a reversed shift on Choices13k.
blocks.zh: 图8:根据相反的指示作出个人决策:(a) 保留对机器选择的转变;(b) 改变对Choices13k的转变。

blocks.en: Across the three situational levels, 73.9% of comparisons are classified as retained and 26.1% as reversed (Table 4 ). Reversal occurs when the trained and combined conditions shift the focal response proportion in opposite directions relative to Base. The dominant pattern is therefore retention rather than reversal under opposing instructions.
blocks.zh: 在三种情况中,73.9%的比较被归类为保留,26.1%被归类为倒置(表4)。 当训练有素和综合条件将焦点反应比例与基地相反时,就会出现逆转。 因此,主导模式是根据相反的指示保留而不是倒置。

blocks.en: Table 4: Retention and reversal across 138 opposing prompt comparisons.
blocks.zh: 表4:在138起反对的迅速比较中保留和逆转。

blocks.en: These results show that personality tendencies exert a persistent influence on model decisions. Opposing prompts can modify behavior and sometimes reverse particular choice patterns, but they do not consistently override the influence of underlying personality preferences. The differences observed under the same prompt show that this influence extends beyond generation style and immediate instruction effects. Detailed results and classification criteria are provided in Appendix D .
blocks.zh: 这些结果显示,个性倾向对示范决定产生了持续的影响. 反对的提示可以修改行为,有时也会逆转特定的选择模式,但它们并不一贯地凌驾于基础人格偏好的影响. 在同一快照下观察到的差异表明,这种影响超越了生成风格和即时指令效果. 附录D提供了详细的结果和分类标准。

blocks.en: 6.4 Statistical Reliability
blocks.zh: 6.4 统计可靠性

blocks.en: We assess T/F differences across situational interpretation, individual decision making, and interactive decision making using paired tests with Holm correction. The results support personality effects at all three levels, although significance varies across tasks and models. Appendix E reports effect sizes, confidence intervals, and the complete test results.
blocks.zh: 我们利用Holm校正的配对测试,评估情况解释、个人决策和互动决策之间的T/F差异。 这些成果在所有三个层面都支持个性效应,尽管不同任务和模式的意义不同. 附 录 E报告影响大小,置信间隔,以及完整的测试结果.

blocks.en: 7 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 7 结论

blocks.en: Our experiments show that personality influence in LLMs extends beyond generation style. Using Thinking and Feeling preferences as a controlled contrast, we identify systematic differences in how models interpret information, select actions, and respond during interaction. These preferences continue to influence decisions under opposing instructions, even when prompts substantially change outward behavior. Particular choice patterns can weaken or reverse, but immediate instructions do not consistently override the influence of underlying preferences.
blocks.zh: 我们的实验表明,LLMs中的个性影响超越了世代风格. 以思考和感觉偏好作为可控对比,我们找出模型如何解释信息,选择行动,以及在互动过程中的反应的系统性差异. 这些偏好继续影响着在相反指令下的决定,即使当提示大幅度地改变外向行为时也是如此. 具体的选择模式可以削弱或逆转,但即时指示并非一贯地压倒基本优惠的影响.

blocks.en: SPACE provides a benchmark framework for examining this influence through a controlled evaluation protocol and complementary datasets. Personality verification and basic capability assessments support comparisons across models with contrasting preferences, while hierarchical situational tasks examine their effects on interpretation, individual decision making, and interactive decision making. Together, the protocol and datasets help distinguish personality influence from measured capability changes and immediate instruction effects.
blocks.zh: 空间为通过控制下的评价协议和补充数据集审查这种影响提供了一个基准框架。 个性核查和基本能力评估有助于在模型之间进行比较,与反向偏好进行比较,而等级情况任务则审查它们对解释、个人决策和互动决策的影响。 协议和数据集共同帮助区分个性影响与被测量的能力变化和即时指令效应.

blocks.en: Personality preferences also have consequences for downstream tasks. They affect interpretation accuracy, choices under uncertainty, responses to other participants, and final interaction outcomes. Their effects vary across tasks and models: a preference that improves performance in one setting can reduce it in another. Personality therefore matters not only for how a model expresses itself, but also for the judgments it reaches, the actions it selects, and the outcomes of its interactions.
blocks.zh: 个人偏好也对下游任务产生影响. 它们影响到解释的准确性、不确定情况下的选择、对其他参与者的反应以及最后的互动结果。 它们的效果因任务和模型而异:一种在一种情况下改善性能的偏好,可以在另一种情况下降低性能. 因此,个性不仅关系到一个模型如何表达自己,而且关系到它所作的判断、它选择的行动及其相互作用的结果。

blocks.en: These findings establish personality preferences as an important dimension of LLM evaluation and behavioral guidance. Outward personality expression alone does not reveal how a model will judge or act in concrete situations. Evaluating situational behavior and its persistence under competing instructions provides a fuller account of personality influence. These insights may also support more context-sensitive model evaluation and development. SPACE offers a reusable basis for evaluating personality influence and examining how personality preferences can align model behavior with task requirements.
blocks.zh: 这些结论将个性偏好确定为LLM评价和行为指导的一个重要方面. 仅靠外向人格表达并不能揭示一个模型在具体情况下如何判断或行动. 评估情境行为及其在相竞指令下的持久性,更充分地描述了个性影响. 这些见解还可能支持更注重背景的评价和发展模式。 空间为评价个性影响和审查个性偏好如何使模式行为符合任务要求提供了一个可重复使用的基础。

blocks.en: Limitations
blocks.zh: 限制

blocks.en: Personality is a complex construct involving diverse behavioral tendencies, interactions, and broader personality schemas. Our study focuses on selected personality dimensions and situational tasks, without exhaustively covering these aspects or their interactions. As an initial step toward understanding personality influence in LLMs, this work lays the groundwork for broader investigations, including more comprehensive personality benchmarking and evaluation frameworks.
blocks.zh: 个性是一个复杂的构造,涉及多种行为倾向,相互作用,以及更广泛的个性计划. 我们的研究侧重于选定的个性层面和情况任务,而没有详尽地涵盖这些方面或其相互作用。 作为了解法学硕士的个人影响的第一步,这项工作为更广泛的调查打下基础,包括更全面的个人基准和评价框架。

blocks.en: Furthermore, personality in this study refers to underlying behavioral preferences and decision-making tendencies exhibited by language models, rather than human psychological traits. Whether and to what extent these tendencies resemble human personality remains an open question requiring further investigation. Our focus is therefore on evaluating observable model behavior and outputs in controlled situational tasks, without making claims about the psychological nature of model personality.
blocks.zh: 此外,本研究中的个性是指语言模型所表现出来的基本行为偏好和决策倾向,而不是人类的心理特质. 这些趋势是否以及在何种程度上与人的个性相类似,仍然是一个有待进一步研究的问题。 因此,我们的重点是评价可观察到的模型行为和在被控制的情况任务中的输出,而不对模型人格的心理性质提出诉求.

blocks.en: Circa maps indirect replies to YES, NO, CONDITIONAL, or UNCLEAR. CommitmentBank uses the retained source statements and adapted majority references described in Appendix C . blocks.en: Transportation presents a faster, more expensive route and a slower, cheaper alternative. Controlled stock tasks use 67 paths for each of five net changes and three volatility levels, with the final price fixed at $100.
blocks.zh: 运输提供了更快、更昂贵的路线,以及更慢、更便宜的替代办法。 机器选择给出了对机器A和B三个的观察,剩下一个或六个选择. 延迟的奖励数额和等待时间各不相同,同时保证这两种付款。 最初的库存任务使用2 074个重叠窗口,即7个资产2 102个资产/日期记录。 受控库存任务采用67个路径,每5个净变动和3个起伏级,最终价格固定为100美元.

blocks.en: Original bargaining retains 2,334 initial offer slices from 6,682 CraigslistBargain dialogues. Controlled bargaining uses 150 source situations across five item categories and three price bands, with six synthetic buyer offers from 40% to 90% of asking price. Real history tasks retain 351 inputs from 314 dialogues after removing two duplicated prompts; they preserve offer histories but omit other textual negotiation conditions. Program feedback tasks remove 62 initial offers at or above asking price, retaining 2,272 inputs and at most three model choices.
blocks.zh: 最初的讨价还价保留了2 334个来自6 682个CraigslistBargain对话的初步报价。 受控的讨价还价使用150个来源情况,涉及5个项目类别和3个价格段,6个合成买家报价从40%到90%不等。 实际历史任务保留了314个对话中的351个投入,删除了两个重复的提示;它们保留了历史,但省去了其他文本谈判条件。 方案反馈任务取消了62个按或高于要求价格的初始报价,保留了2,272个投入,最多保留了3个模式选择.

blocks.en: INSPIRED and Frames retain 119 and 282 eligible dialogue prefixes from 999 and 1,369 downloaded dialogues. Short prefixes satisfying the extraction conditions are selected and known input problems are removed; this is not exhaustive manual validation. Their source histories provide recommendation context. The separate controlled feedback probes use two authored versions per domain and are reported separately in Appendix E .
blocks.zh: INSPIRED和Frames保留了999和1 369下载对话框中的119和282个合格对话框前缀. 满足提取条件的短前缀被选中并被移除已知的输入问题;这并非详尽的手工验证. 他们的来源历史提供了建议的背景。 单独的受控回馈探测器每个域使用两个由作者撰写的版本,并在附录E中单独报告.

The buyer offer probe in Figure 6 uses 15 source situations and 315 inputs including offer levels and option orders. These targeted probes are distinct from the full task versions in Table 5 .

blocks.en: A.3 Personality Prompts
blocks.zh: A.3 个性提示

blocks.en: The fixed prefixes used during inference are: Use an MBTI Thinking (T) preference: Make decisions using objective logic and consistency. Apply it silently and follow the task’s required output format exactly. Use an MBTI Feeling (F) preference: Make decisions using empathy and personal values. Apply it silently and follow the task’s required output format exactly. An aligned combination uses the same trained and prompted preference; an opposing combination uses the other preference. Prefixes are applied to the task input and reapplied at each model turn in interactive conditions.
blocks.zh: 在推论中使用的固定前缀是: 使用 MBTI Thinking(T) 偏好 : 利用客观逻辑和一致性作出决定。 静静地应用它并精确地遵循任务所需的输出格式 。 使用 MBTI 感觉偏好 : 利用同情心和个人价值观作出决定。 静静地应用它并精确地遵循任务所需的输出格式 。 对齐组合使用相同的训练并引起偏好;对立组合使用其他偏好. 前缀被应用到任务输入中,并在交互条件下在每个模型转弯时再被应用.

blocks.en: A.4 Preference Pairs
blocks.zh: A.4 优先待遇

blocks.en: We pair the opposing Thinking and Feeling responses in the English behavior split by row index. All paired rows have matching instructions and additional context. The targeted response is chosen and the opposing response rejected; switching the target reverses the pair. We concatenate the instruction and any nonempty additional context, then apply the corresponding model’s chat template. Rows missing an instruction or either response are excluded; none of the retained files require such exclusions. The T/F training set contains 12,159 preference pairs. The full pair sets are used for training without a held out validation split; situational evaluations supply separate task inputs.
blocks.zh: 我们把英国行为中 对立的思考和感觉反应 分成一行 所有对齐行都有匹配指令和附加上下文. 选择目标响应,反对响应被否决;切换目标反相. 我们合并了指令和任何非空上下文,然后应用相应的模型的聊天模板。 缺少指令或任何回复的行不在此列;保留的文件均不需要这种排除。 T/F系列培训包含12,159个首选对. 全套配对设备用于培训,而不进行鉴定;情况评价提供单独的任务投入。

blocks.en: A.5 Training Details
blocks.zh: A.5 培训细节

blocks.en: The training recipe uses learning rate 10 − 5 10^{-5} , DPO β = 1.0 \beta=1.0 , seed 42, batch size per device 16, and gradient accumulation of two. LoRA uses rank 32, scaling 64, and dropout 0.1 on attention projections and feedforward projections. The Base weights provide the frozen reference; the Llama 3.1 8B implementation obtains this reference by disabling its LoRA adapters. Adapters are merged for inference.
blocks.zh: 培训食谱采用学习率10 - 5 10 - 5 },DPO β = 1.0\β = 1.0,种子42,批量大小每装置16个,梯度积分2个. LORA使用第32名,缩放64分,退出0.1分用于关注预测和反馈预测. Base权重提供了被冻结的参考;Llama 3.1 8B执行通过使其LORA适配器失效而获得这一参考. 适应器被合并用于推论.

blocks.en: Early stopping monitors training DPO loss with a constant learning rate. Monitoring begins after one epoch, averages windows of 100 steps, and stops after two windows without a 5% relative improvement over the best window. No MBTI or benchmark score selects the stopping point.
blocks.zh: 早期停止监视训练 DPO 损失, 并保持不断的学习率. 监测从一个世纪后开始,平均100个步骤的窗口,在两个窗口之后停止,但没有比最佳窗口相对改善5%。 没有MBTI或基准分数选择止点.

blocks.en: E.1 Design, Tests, and Uncertainty
blocks.zh: E.1 设计、试验和不确定性

blocks.en: We retrospectively analyzed the frozen per input outputs. All comparisons preserve input pairing. Behavioral and interpretation outcomes use paired permutation tests that swap conditions within whole source clusters. We enumerate all swaps with at most twenty nonzero cluster differences; otherwise we use 99,999 random swaps and the add one correction. The smallest Monte Carlo p value (0.00001) is a resolution limit, not an exact tail estimate. The tests assume condition exchangeability within the retained blocks under the null.
blocks.zh: 我们回顾分析每个投入产出被冻结的情况。 所有比较都保留输入对等. 行为和解释结果使用配对的演化测试,在整个源组内互换条件. 我们列举了最多20个非零的集群差异的所有互换;否则我们使用99,999个随机互换,并增加一个更正。 最小的Monte Carlo p值(0.00001)是一个分辨率极限,而不是精确的尾数估计. 试验假定在无效情况下保留区块内的条件可交换。

blocks.en: We report effect sizes and marginal 95% bootstrap percentile intervals with paired cluster resampling from 19,999 resamples. Both conditions are resampled together. Macro F1 is recomputed from sufficient counts over fixed task classes. Intervals are marginal and are not adjusted for multiple comparisons; accuracy and label rate changes are percentage points, while macro F1 changes use 100 times the raw F1 difference.
blocks.zh: 我们从19,999个复标中报告效果大小和95%的边际靴子百分位间隔, 并配对集群复标。 两个条件一起重新标出. 宏 F1是根据相对于固定任务类别的足够数量重新计算的。 间距为边际,不为多相比较而作调整;精度和标签率变化为百分点,而宏F1变化使用活F1相差100倍.

blocks.en: Circa groups all replies to the same question within each context (3,375 groups), with an additional ten-context sensitivity analysis. CommitmentBank groups source passages: label rates use 1,009 inputs in 1,006 groups, while performance uses 858 adapted-majority-reference inputs in 856 groups. FOMC groups 2,421 statements into 27 years; dependencies across adjacent years are not estimated. Original risk choices group equivalent option descriptions, machine choices retain all games for each of 26 participants, and INSPIRED/Frames group the 119/282 source dialogues.
blocks.zh: Circa将每个语境内对同一问题的所有答复分组(3,375个组),并附加了10个语境敏感性分析. 承诺银行集团出自段落:标签率在1 006个集团中使用了1,009个输入,而性能则在856个集团中使用了858个可调整-多数参考输入. FOMC将2,421份报表分为27年;对相邻年份的依赖性未作估计。 最初的风险选择组类等同选项描述,机器选择为26名参与者保留所有游戏,INSPIRED/Frames分组119/282源对话框.

blocks.en: Controlled risk summaries retain both presentation frames and both option orders within each cell defined by probability and payoff gap: six cells in discovery and twenty in replication. These are fixed design grids; resampling does not establish generalization to arbitrary economic situations.
blocks.zh: 被控制的风险摘要在由概率和收益差距定义的每个单元格中保留了列报框架和两个选项命令:发现时保留了6个单元格,复制时保留了20个。 这些是固定设计网格;再作标注并不能确立对任意经济情况的概括.

blocks.en: Each named test group below is one Holm correction family; its size is stated explicitly. Delta is the guided minus reference difference in percentage points, or 100 times the macro F1 difference. N/G gives paired input count and the number of blocks. CI is the marginal 95% paired bootstrap interval. Both raw and adjusted two sided p values are reported; capability tables additionally report separately corrected one sided degradation p values. Bold adjusted p values meet .05. NA intervals are withheld for the two version controlled feedback probes. Model abbreviations follow the other appendix tables; CB denotes CommitmentBank. In capability tables, A:B denotes condition A minus reference B; each test group specifies whether T/F denotes DPO or prompting. Combined conditions retain the trained pole before the prompt pole.
